rules: Do not infer material contents, official unit boundaries, or access from a catalog label or URL.
Do not copy authenticated, paywalled, restricted, or rights-unclear material into learner-safe storage.
A later authorized retrieval job must record the final locator, retrieval time, content hash, license or access basis, and source relationship.
Retrieved records remain materials until separately classified; retrieval alone does not make them official course units.
Official-unit expansion requires unit-level scope, ordering, dependencies, and harness-controlled validation evidence.
If access fails or rights remain unclear, preserve the blocked record and use an independently authored substitute rather than claiming the source was obtained.
